identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Biomarker Explanation of IBI-322 Plus Lenvatinib on Extensive Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Biomarker Explanation of IBI-322 Plus Lenvatinib on Extensive Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer Who Failed From First Line PD-(L)-1 Inhibitors: Multiple Cohorts Perspective Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aimed to explore the efficacy and biomarker explanation of IBI-322 Plus Lenvatinib on extensive stage small cell lung cancer who failed from first line PD-(L)1 inhibitors.

armGroups.label: Cohort A
armGroups.description: Duration of response time less than 3 months

armGroups.label: Cohort B
armGroups.description: Duration of response time between 3 and 6 months

armGroups.label: Cohort C
armGroups.description: Duration of response time more than 6 months

interventions.name: IBI-322 Plus Lenvatinib
interventions.description: IBI322 is based on the "3+3" model, with a dose ascent starting from 10mg

primaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the proportion of subjects in complete remission (CR) and partial remission (PR) to the total subjects

secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from the beginning of treatment to the first imaging disease progression or death (whichever occurs first)
Defined as the time from the start of treatment to the death of the subject due to any cause.
